scriptLines: source1 derive(CodigoRuta = upper(trim(iif(isNull(CodigoRuta) || trim(CodigoRuta) == '' || upper(trim(CodigoRuta)) == 'NULL', 'SIN_CODIGO', CodigoRuta))),

derivedColumn1 derive(RutaHistoricaId = upper(substring( iif(startsWith(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'RH-'), trim(RutaHistoricaId), iif(startsWith(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'RUTA '), concat('RH-', lpad(replace(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'RUTA ', ''), 2, '0')), iif(startsWith(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'R'), replace(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'R-', 'RH-'), concat('RH-', lpad(trim(RutaHistoricaId), 2, '0'))))), 1, 5 ))) ~> derivedColumn2

derivedColumn2 derive(VigenciaDesde = toDate(iif(instr(VigenciaDesde, '/') > 0, toString(toDate(VigenciaDesde, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), iif(instr(VigenciaDesde, '-') > 0, VigenciaDesde, toString(addDays(toDate('1899-12-30', 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toInteger(VigenciaDesde)), 'yyyy-MM-dd'))), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),

VigenciaHasta = toDate(iif(instr(VigenciaHasta, '/') > 0, toString(toDate(VigenciaHasta, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), iif(instr(VigenciaHasta, '-') > 0, VigenciaHasta, toString(addDays(toDate('1899-12-30', 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toInteger(VigenciaHasta)), 'yyyy-MM-dd'))), 'yyyy-MM-dd')) ~> derivedColumn3
